description: Extractive summary with TextRank (Mihalcea & Tarau 2004): sentences are split (abbreviation / initial / decimal aware), linked by stemmed content-word overlap, ranked with PageRank, and the top N are returned in original order. No LLM, no hallucination: every summary sentence is verbatim from the input, with its index, score and offset. Choose a sentence count or a ratio. Offline, deterministic; 200 KB input. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/summarize-extractive

ratio.description: Keep this fraction of sentences instead (overrides sentences)
